description: Checkout is slow. A payment-gateway deploy 12 minutes before start added a slow fraud-score check to card authorization (S1).

log_excerpts: Checkout pages slower than usual; booking, search and login pages normal
POST /checkout/confirm p95 2.4s; 92% of request time spent waiting on payment-gateway /authorize
Upstream timeout calling payment-gateway after 2500ms, retrying once
Processor client timeout is now 2000ms; requests queueing behind fraud-score calls

deploys.change_summary: Add a synchronous fraud-score check to card authorization and raise the processor client timeout from 800 ms to 2 s.
Fix wording in reschedule confirmation emails.
Redesign the provider profile page header.
Retry SMS sends when the SMS provider returns 429.
